title: Enum cases should be sorted.
summary: Its name is Sorted Enum Cases. It is in the style kind of rules. It is an opt-in rule, so SwiftLint runs it only when the configuration enables it.

title: Prefer using `min()` or `max()` over `sorted().first` or `sorted().last`.
summary: Its name is Min or Max over Sorted First or Last. It is in the performance kind of rules. It is an opt-in rule, so SwiftLint runs it only when the configuration enables it.

title: Imports should be sorted.
summary: Its name is Sorted Imports. It is in the style kind of rules. It is an opt-in rule, so SwiftLint runs it only when the configuration enables it. swiftlint --fix can correct it.

title: '#sourceLocation' directive produces '#fileID' string of '…', which conflicts with '#fileID' strings produced by other paths in the module.
message_templates: '#sourceLocation' directive produces '#fileID' string of '{}', which conflicts with '#fileID' strings produced by other paths in the module
